title: Manga 'Killing Bites' Concludes with 28th Volume
content: Shinya Murata and Kazasa Sumita 's Killing Bites manga ended its serialization on October 23. The 145th and final chapter marked the end of its nearly 13-year run. The 28th and final volume is scheduled to be released on December 25.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Rainy Day Serenade Anime's Teaser Reveals Cast, Staff, April 2027 Debut
content: Bandai Namco Filmworks unveiled a new teaser promotional video and first key visual for the television anime of Haruka Kawachi 's Rainy Day Serenade ( Namidaame to Serenade ) manga on Friday. The teaser reveals the anime's main cast, staff, and April 2027 premiere date for the anime.
author: ANN

title: Wound & Bandage Anime's New Video Reveals More Cast & Staff, Opening Song
content: The official website for television anime of Umihoshi Nanai 's Wound & Bandage ( Kizuguchi to Hōtai ) manga unveiled the full promotional video and a key visual for the anime on Friday.
author: ANN

title: 'Yuru Camp△ Season 4' Reveals Additional Staff, Theme Songs, Main Promo, Spring 2027 Premiere
content: • The official website of the Yuru Camp△ ( Laid-Back Camp ) anime series revealed additional staff, theme songs, main visual (pictured), and main promotional video for Season 4 on Friday. The new season adapting Afro 's slice of life manga will begin airing in April 2027.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Laid-Back Camp Season 4 Anime Reveals New Trailer, Visual, April 2027 Release Date
content: Laid-Back Camp Season 4 anime released a new visual and trailer, along with an April 2027 release date. FuRyu Pictures is animating the fourth season, replacing 8-bit. The theme songs for the fourth season have also been revealed: Asaka and Eri Sasaki both return to sing the opening theme song and ending theme song,…
author: Anime Corner

title: Laid-Back Camp Season 4's Trailer Unveils April 2027 Debut
content: The official website for the television anime of Afro 's Laid-Back Camp manga presented the main trailer and main visual for the anime's fourth season on Friday. The trailer and visual announce the season's April 2027 premiere, and the trailer also previews the theme songs.
author: ANN

title: 'Kizuguchi to Houtai' Reveals Additional Cast, Staff, Opening Theme, First Promo
content: The official website for the television anime adaptation of Nanai Umihoshi 's Kizuguchi to Houtai ( Wound and Bandage ) manga revealed additional cast, staff, a key visual (pictured), the opening theme, and first promotional video on Friday. The anime series will premiere on January 9, 2027 at 11:00 p.m.
author: MyAnimeList

title: He Does a Body Good Webtoon Gets AnimeFesta Anime in January 2027
content: Suiseisha announced on Friday that Lee Wonsik and Park Hyeongjun's He Does a Body Good ( Karada ni Ii Otoko ) webtoon is inspiring an AnimeFesta anime that will premiere next January. The anime's website notes that WWWave Corporation 's OceanVeil service will stream the anime in English.
author: ANN

title: Booty Royale: Never Go Down Without a Fight! Manga Gets TV Anime in January
content: WWWave Corporation announced on Friday that its Deregula anime label is producing an anime adaptation of Rui Takatō 's Booty Royale: Never Go Down Without a Fight! ( Hagure Idol Jigokuhen ) manga that will premiere in January 2027.
author: ANN

title: Manga 'Hagure Idol: Jigoku-hen' Gets TV Anime in Winter 2027
content: WWWave Corporation 's Deregula animation label opened an official website for a television anime adaptation of Rui Takatou 's Hagure Idol: Jigoku-hen ( Booty Royale: Never Go Down Without a Fight! ) manga on Friday, revealing the main cast, staff, and a commemorative visual (pictured).
author: MyAnimeList
